post.instagram_caption:
$1,000 in Apple's first shares in 1980 would be worth about $3.5 million today, before dividends. It's hindsight, so here's the math.

Apple went public on December 12, 1980 at $22 a share, so $1,000 bought 45 shares. Five stock splits (2-for-1 in 1987, 2000 and 2005, 7-for-1 in 2014, 4-for-1 in 2020) turned each share into 224, so 45 shares became 10,080. Apple closed at a record $349.51 on November 4, 2026, which makes those shares worth about $3.52 million. But most stocks never do this: a study of nearly 26,000 US stocks from 1926 to 2016 by Hendrik Bessembinder found 58% failed to beat Treasury bills over their lifetimes. Price as of the November 4, 2026 close.
